predeclared_protocol.holdout_reuse: none (15 freshly generated datasets with distinct SHA-256 digests; each sealed test gate consumed exactly once)

arms.m3_raw_single_family: Raw-feature single-family baseline (interactions=false, missing_indicators=false, target_encoding=false, calibration=null, 3 folds)
arms.m6_composite_pipeline: Composite scheduled pipeline (fold-local interactions=true, missing_indicators=true, target_encoding=true, calibration=sigmoid where applicable, heterogeneous linear+tree parents, voting/stacking, 3 folds)

predeclared_protocol.statistical_policy: Report exact per-seed metrics, paired signed improvements, mean/SD/min/max, and win/tie/loss counts. Identical scores are reported as ties, never statistical equivalence.
